description: This is the main FastAPI application source code for the AI Copilot backend. It defines API endpoints for health checks, session management, chat interactions, and model listing, integrating with external services like Gemini API and session management. It also configures CORS policies and loads environment variables.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: Manages chat sessions, including creation, message history, and message addition.

classes.name: GeminiService
classes.description: Handles interaction with the Google Gemini API, including listing models and generating replies.

methods.name: health_check
methods.description: Endpoint to check if the API is running and healthy.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Creates a new chat session with a unique UUID.

methods.name: chat
methods.description: Handles sending a message to the AI and returning the response, managing session history and API calls.

methods.name: get_session_history
methods.description: Retrieves the message history for a specific session.

methods.name: list_gemini_models
methods.description: Lists available Gemini models via the Gemini API.
